scope.aggregate_rankings: Rank system means over all 119 topics, using scored outputs' all rows. These differ from mean correlations of within-topic rankings.
scope.ordinal_alpha: Per topic: candidate systems are units; score columns are raters; average ranks for ties; higher is better, reversing critical-error rate. Checked all 238 values against installed krippendorff ordinal implementation.
scope.cross_metric: Uses emitted aggregates, without availability adjustment; inherits zero sentinels, failures, truncation, and per-measure denominator conventions.
scope.pooled_alpha: Twelve overlapping outputs target different constructs; exploratory concordance only, not reliability of a single quality variable. No threshold classifications.
interpretation: Describes judge agreement, not user preferences or quality validation
Cross-run differences do not isolate rubric effects without repeat runs
Lower AP-b than Kendall tau-b is a second top-weighted view, not proof that every discrepancy occurs at the top
Critical-error aggregate ties are slightly CSV-parser sensitive; critical-error pair coefficients are omitted from paper
scope.verification: All 288 heatmap cells reproduced from saved scored outputs in previous turn; 144 Kendall cells also matched SciPy; source files and analysis commit recorded here.
